**1.033: A warning when the microphone hears nothing.**

- **Silence guard:** if a recording has run for 10 seconds and the microphone hasn't picked up any sound at all (muted, blocked by Android's microphone toggle, or the wrong input), Hebrish shows a warning, so you don't dictate into nothing. The recording carries on. In the voice keyboard, the floating mic and the app's own dictation screen.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
